description: Silver Touch Hospitals is a leading Kidney Failure Treatment Hospital in Ahmedabad, offering Kidney Stone Treatment, Kidney Transplant, Nephrologist & affordable kidney care.
html:
Reliable Kidney Specialist Hospital in Ahmedabad

At Silver Touch Hospitals, we offer quality care for any kidney issues under our specialised nephrology department. Whether you or a family member is suffering from chronic kidney disease, uncontrollable hypertension, acute renal failure, or complicated urological issues, we are here to assist with on-time diagnosis, skilled treatment, and ongoing support.

We’re proud to be known as a leading kidney specialist hospital in Ahmedabad, with nephrology units across our network of hospitals. Our centres are equipped to handle everything from outpatient consultations to critical care for patients with kidney complications.

Why Silver Touch Hospitals for Kidney Care?

We know how complicated kidney disorders are. That’s why we employ the right people, infrastructure, and experience at all of our hospitals to ensure patients receive consistent, quality care.

As a full-service kidney hospital in Ahmedabad, we offer:

  • Senior nephrologists and urologists
  • Advanced renal imaging and laboratory diagnostics
  • Dialysis units (haemodialysis and peritoneal)
  • ICU care for patients with multi-organ complications
  • Dietary counselling and lifestyle advice for kidney health

Whether you are dealing with early-stage kidney disease or with chronic renal failure, we offer the care and education necessary for long-term health.

Nephrology Hospital in Ahmedabad with a Patient-Centred Approach

Our vision is to provide expert kidney care that is accessible, affordable, and compassionate. As a well-established nephrology hospital in Ahmedabad, Silver Touch Hospitals doesn’t just concentrate on treatment but also enhances the quality of life for patients and their families.

We teach patients to recognise early warning signs, make lifestyle changes, and manage diseases in the long term. From normal check-ups to emergency treatment, our nephrology services are available 24/7 at all locations.

If you are experiencing kidney problems or need specialist consultation, visit our nephrology team at Silver Touch Hospitals. We are dedicated to enabling you to live longer, healthier, and pain-free.

faqs.q: Do you have outpatient and inpatient kidney services?
faqs.a: Yes. We offer routine consultations, diagnostics, dialysis, and hospitalisation for patients requiring intensive treatment or surgery.

faqs.q: Do you have dialysis facilities in all Silver Touch Hospitals?
faqs.a: Yes, we provide dialysis at more than one branch. Our facilities are geared for haemodialysis and peritoneal dialysis.

faqs.q: Do you assist in insurance or government schemes for the treatment of the kidneys?
faqs.a: Yes, Silver Touch Hospitals are empanelled with most insurance companies and health schemes, including PMJAY. Kindly discuss with our billing team for details.

faqs.q: Can I get a second opinion on my kidney diagnosis at Silver Touch?
faqs.a: Yes. Our nephrology department gives second opinions on a regular basis to patients who have previously been diagnosed. You can schedule a consultation with a senior specialist, and we will go through all pertinent medical reports, scans, and test results.

faqs.q: What do I need to bring to my initial consultation with a kidney specialist?
faqs.a: Kindly bring any available medical records, medications, previous test reports (such as blood/urine reports, sonography, or CT scans), and a record of medications currently in use. This aids our experts in properly evaluating your situation and proposing the appropriate course of treatment.
